inherit_from: GET DATA SPEC OR MODEL SPEC

supervised_singlehand_img.split: split from which data should be read
supervised_singlehand_img.mini_dataset: if mini_dataset dict is empty & use_mini_dataset is True
json file in './misc would be received
supervised_singlehand_img.add_first_last_frame: supervised fraction could be used to turn off supervisory of some frames
supervised_singlehand_img.images_features: images_features are saved extracted features from a pretrained net
supervised_singlehand_img.labelset: label_set would be avaliable_annotation in loader
